inference: Native PyTorch deterministic mean action; no optimization or exploration noise
mount_rule: All four wheel centers inside top footprint and within 6.5 cm of top+0.086 m; at least two supporting contacts >5 N; gravity_z<-0.7; continuous 0.1 s
pass_rule: After mount, all wheels beyond platform back+0.05 m, body beyond back+0.35 m, all wheel centers within 8 cm of ground+0.086 m, supported and upright for 0.2 s
failure_rule: First termination, timeout, or body |y|>0.75 m ends attempt; autoresets never create another attempt
